edition: Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix (HD gameplay screenshots)
method: Viewed actual puzzle-editing UI screenshots via publicly accessible img.youtube.com thumbnails. Counted tile widths/heights against board edges and visible displaced/selected tiles; read the placement-only versus rotation help text. Dimensions were not inferred from artwork aspect ratio. Image reference and underlying video are retained per record. Starting rotations are state-dependent; use the upright artwork and guide piece numbering rather than a fixed input sequence.

records.name: Awakening
records.reference: Sora stands upright in the center; Donald and Goofy portraits sit at the upper left and upper right, with Kairi and Riku at the lower left and lower right.

records.name: Heart
records.reference: Mickey is at the top, Roxas and Goofy below him, and Kairi and Sora fill the lower half; the silver heart ends in a downward point.

records.name: Duality
records.reference: Kairi and Naminé stand inside the yellow heart at the top; Roxas faces forward at the bottom with his arms spread.

records.name: Frontier
records.reference: The castle fills the upper background. Sora and Roxas stand behind Mickey, Kairi, Donald and Goofy; Kairi sits on the blue ledge with her feet near the bottom.

records.name: Daylight
records.reference: Sora and Riku occupy the upper left, Mickey the center, and the dark castle the upper right. Marluxia, Larxene, Zexion and Vexen line the bottom.

records.name: Sunset
records.reference: The sunset town and lamps sit at the upper left; Roxas and Sora occupy the upper center and right. Xigbar, Luxord and Saïx line the bottom, with Xemnas at the lower right.

inspections.result: HTTP403; wiki file-description HTML accessible but image not downloaded.
All six artwork files downloaded and viewed, but no tile boundaries. Frontier is a cropped wide version of its artwork; not used to establish grid dimensions.
Thumbnail responses were Site Unavailable HTML, while public img.youtube.com thumbnail URLs returned actual gameplay images.
